thread:
Deploy a Symfony App to Production, the Honest Way

Quick thread 🧵

To deploy a Symfony app: set `APP_ENV=prod` and a real `APP_SECRET` on the server, run `composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader`, then `bin/console cache:clear` and `cache:warmup`, then `doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction`.
Serve `public/index.php` with nginx and PHP-FPM, and make sure `var/cache` and `var/log` are writable by the web server user.
That last one is the classic 500.
